identity.note: UFC athlete page (first pass): Michael Chandler, lightweight, High Ridge MO, USA. Missouri athletics roster lists the same wrestler from High Ridge, Mo. (Northwest High School, 2004), matching his UFC hometown.

claims.text: Placed fifth at 157 lb at the 2009 NCAA Division I Championships for Missouri, earning All-American status.
Missouri's report from the 2009 NCAA finals day records him finishing fifth at 157 lb with a 5-2 tournament record.
Wrestled four seasons at 157 lb for Missouri (2004-05 to 2008-09) and had qualified for the NCAA Division I Championships three times before his final season.
Finished second at 152 lb at the 2004 Missouri state high school championships for Northwest High School.
Beat Chad Mendes 4-1 on points in a wrestling match at Real American Freestyle 3 in Chicago, his debut for that professional wrestling promotion.

sources_checked.name: National Wrestling Hall of Fame All-American record

wrestling.note: Earlier claim of multiple All-American finishes is not supported: NWHOF and Missouri both show one All-American finish, fifth at 157 lb in 2009. The 2007-08 Missouri roster page counts three NCAA qualifications before his final season, so four in total.
